candidate_source_binding: the additive primitive implementation, same-binary gate, tests, custody inputs, and this predeclaration must be committed and pushed together before the first candidate performance sample

scope.stage: primitive screen only; a pass authorizes full boundary-tail plumbing but is not an end-to-end acceptance
scope.weight_format: ApxInf W8 G64 with F32 scales
scope.fixture: deterministic finite synthetic values with production dimensions

arms.A: legacy gate/up rows followed by a separate SiLU-times-up dispatch in the same production-shaped encoder
arms.B: one SIMDgroup per semantic gate/up row pair, shared input load, two independent accumulators, direct SiLU-times-up publication

hypothesis.change: keep each row's lane mapping, W8 weight and scale mapping, dot-product term order, SIMD reduction, down projection, command-buffer submission, wait, and host transfer unchanged while pairing the matching gate and up rows and eliminating the standalone activation dispatch and its following buffer barrier

source_derived_primitive_mapping.interpretation: logical source mapping, not a cache or DRAM counter measurement

projected_full_path_mapping_if_primitive.qualification: projection only; no full-path result is claimed by this primitive screen

admission.primitive_harness_classification: always non-formal diagnostic; it does not itself attest host quietness and cannot promote or default a runtime path
admission.if_quiet_host_fails: complete the fixed schedule only as explicitly non-formal diagnostic evidence

performance_continue_threshold.clearly_negative_block_definition: reject immediately if either block has candidate latency improvement at or below -0.5 percent
performance_continue_threshold.result_if_passed: authorize additive full boundary-tail profile plumbing and a separate predeclared end-to-end gate
performance_continue_threshold.result_if_failed: archive the fixed receipts and summary, then revert candidate implementation while retaining the predeclaration and rejection evidence

fixed_schedule.correctness_requirement: all four outputs for every input are finite and match to_bits element-by-element
fixed_schedule.warmup_block_1: ABBA with 64 consecutive calls per cell
fixed_schedule.warmup_block_2: BAAB with 64 consecutive calls per cell
fixed_schedule.timed_block_1: ABBA with 64 consecutive calls per cell
fixed_schedule.timed_block_2: BAAB with 64 consecutive calls per cell
fixed_schedule.timing: host monotonic elapsed time around one complete synchronous primitive call
fixed_schedule.primary_statistic: even median (mean of the two central samples) per arm within each block and pooled per arm
